title: Seokju Kang
text:
SEOKJU KANG





Hello, I’m Seokju Kang. I am currently a Ph.D. student in Management Engineering at UNIST, supervised by Prof. Hyun Jin Jang. Before that, I completed my B.S. in Industrial Engineering from Pusan Nat’l University.


My research domain is in Financial Engineering, with particular emphasis on risk management, derivatives pricing, and quantitative methods in finance. I am also working on AI/OR applications in finance.




E-mail: jukang@unist.ac.kr
